description: This file defines the MultipartCopy class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for managing multipart copy operations in Amazon S3. It includes methods for initiating, uploading parts, and completing multipart copy, along with handling source metadata and configuration options.

classes.name: MultipartCopy
classes.description: Manages multipart copy operations for S3 objects, supporting pausing/resuming and detailed configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartCopy object with a client, source location, and configuration, setting up the source data.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Alias for the upload method to start the copy process.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Loads the info about the upload commands for initiate, upload, and complete.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generator yielding the upload part commands for ongoing multipart upload.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates and returns the data array for a specific part of the multipart copy, including range headers.

methods.name: extractETag
methods.description: Extracts the ETag from the ResultInterface of a completed upload part.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the source object.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the source object.

methods.name: getSourceMetadata
methods.description: Fetches and caches metadata for the source object.

methods.name: fetchSourceMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the source object using headObject, using custom parameters if provided.

methods.name: getInputSource
methods.description: Returns the decoded input source string starting with a slash, handling ARNs appropriately.

search-terms: Multipart upload in AWS SDK PHP
